PolyCup

By Kiki · PolyTrack 0.6.3

Live Cups for 2–8 racers. Choose Standard for bans, picks and a finalist finish, or Quickplay for random maps and a straight points race. Customize and share your own presets.

Includes practice, live checkpoint rankings, racer POV, records, and organizer controls.

Open with the PolyCup toolbar button or F8. G toggles other players’ ghosts; rebind it in Settings. Full restart retires you from a live round.

All participants need the same mod version. The organizer must stay connected.
